On each round, both players independently choose ROCK, PAPER, or SCISSORS without seeing the other player's current choice. ROCK beats SCISSORS, SCISSORS beats PAPER, and PAPER beats ROCK. Equal choices result in a tie. After each completed round, both choices and the result are revealed. Your objective is to win as many rounds as possible.
